name: Suddenly Royal
source: As a struggling grad student, you don’t believe in fairytales—until your life becomes one. When you discover you’re the long-lost heiress to a duchy in the distant country of Lilaria, you’re forced to admit that maybe fairy tales do come true.
translation: 作为一名苦苦挣扎的研究生，你不相信童话——直到你的生活变成童话。当你发现自己是遥远国家利拉里亚的一个公国失散已久的女继承人时，你不得不承认也许童话故事确实成真了。
